motor: This is DFRobot:motor user motor and steering control function.
motor.Dir: The user defines the motor rotation direction.
motor.Motors: The user selects the 4-way dc motor.
motor.Servos: The user can select the 8 steering gear controller.
motor.Stepper: The user can choose the step motor model.
motor.Steppers: The user can select a two-path stepper motor controller.
motor.stepperDegreeDual_42: Two parallel stepper motors are executed simultaneously(DegreeDual).
motor.stepperTurnDual_42: Two parallel stepper motors are executed simultaneously(Turn).
